entries.title: Previews of your project's screens use its own look and fonts
entries.body: When a crewmate shows you a preview or a drawing of your project's screens, it draws them in your project's own colors, type and controls instead of Infinitary's, while the card's own words keep Infinitary's look. A preview can use your project's own font files: Infinitary checks each one before the card goes up, so a damaged font sends the crewmate back to fix it. This works for tasks on your other computers and on a paired Mac too, once that computer is updated.

picture.alt: A card previewing a wallet app's balance screen in that project's own rounded typeface, under the card's title in Infinitary's type
